dedupe_keys.name: a large scale residential load dataset in a southern province of china

description: A Large-Scale Residential Load Dataset in a Southern Province of China is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Bo Li et al. Granular, localized data can inform planning for a net-zero energy system, particularly in underdeveloped regions. Understanding residential electricity consumption (especially in response to extreme weather events such as heatwaves and tropical storms) can guide efforts to improve grid resilience and optimize energy management strategies. However, such data are often scarce. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2025. Formats: SQLite. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 348616952 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is MIT, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
